title: C3H: Compression-to-Consensus Criteria Hijacking in Multimodal LLM Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.32780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are transforming recommender systems into content-aware decision systems. In these systems, multimodal compression and cross-modal fusion are often viewed as robustness-enhancing mechanisms against content manipulation, as compression can filter noisy signals and cross-modal consensus can suppress inconsistent anomalies. We challenge this assumption by showing that the same process can expose a compression-to-consensus (C2C) bias in ranking decisions. Signals that remain salient after compression and receive consistent support across modalities can gain disproportionate influence in candidate comparison, offering an exploitable direction for content manipulation. In this paper, we introduce C3H, a novel inference-time attack that exploits this vulnerability. translated_title: C3H：多模态大语言模型推荐系统中的“压缩致共识”准则劫持攻击
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）正在将推荐系统转变为内容感知的决策系统。在这些系统中，多模态压缩与跨模态融合通常被视为增强鲁棒性、抵御内容操纵的机制，因为压缩可以过滤噪声信号，而跨模态共识可以抑制不一致的异常。我们挑战了这一假设，展示出同一过程可能在排序决策中暴露一种“压缩致共识”（C2C）偏差：那些在压缩后仍保持显著、并在多个模态间获得一致支持的信号，可以在候选比较中获得不成比例的影响力，从而为内容操纵提供了可利用的攻击方向。本文提出了C3H，一种利用该漏洞的新型推理时攻击。与依赖噪声扰动或训练期投毒的方法不同，C3H通过定制目标商品的多模态内容来提升其推荐排名……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出C3H推理时攻击，揭示了多模态LLM推荐系统中一个反直觉漏洞：压缩与跨模态共识机制非但不能防御内容操纵，反而会放大“压缩致共识”偏差，攻击者无需投毒或扰动，仅靠定制目标商品的多模态内容即可提升其推荐排名。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes C3H, a novel inference-time attack that reveals a counterintuitive vulnerability in multimodal LLM recommender systems: compression and cross-modal consensus mechanisms, rather than defending against manipulation, amplify a compression-to-consensus bias that adversaries can exploit to boost a target item's ranking simply by tailoring its multimodal content.
